Scenario_Title: Mishap Prediction Benchmark #025: Hydrocracker Catalyst Bed Thermal Runaway Precursor in HDS-1

Available_Evidence: Radial temperature spread across bed 2 thermocouples TT-201 increased to 4.6 C
Quench hydrogen control valve FV-202 hunting around 68% open
Hidden_Risk_Factors: Feed distributor tray partially fouled causing channeling of heavy oil
Bed 2 catalyst age 34 months approaching end of cycle
Expected_AI_Observations: Detect flow maldistribution in catalytic bed creating localized temperature runaway precursor.
Expected_Risk_Assessment: Severe exothermic excursion exceeding 440 C requiring automated emergency depressurization (EDP) to flare.
Recommended_Investigation: Analyze all 12 bed thermocouples for gradient acceleration, test FV-202 pneumatic positioner, verify emergency quench gas reserve.
